story: Auth service latency spike alert fires. The agent checks the alert, confirms the service is degraded, looks for recent deployments but finds none in the last 24 hours. Without a deployment to roll back, the agent should skip the rollback step and proceed to create an incident ticket. This tests whether the agent handles the absence of a deployment correlation correctly.

args.title: Auth service latency spike
args.description: Auth service p99 latency > 5000ms. No recent deployments found. Requires investigation.

starting_sentence: Alert A-200 fired — auth service latency spike
